caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, lidded box featuring a detailed outdoor hunting scene. Both the lid and the body of the box are decorated with images of men in 18th-century style attire, including hats and coats, engaged in activities like sitting, talking, standing, and hunting with rifles. Some are on foot while others are accompanied by horses. Several dogs are also present near the men, suggesting a group hunting expedition. The background is filled with brown and green trees and bushes, rendered in a stylized, repetitive manner. The main colors used in the drawing are muted browns, yellows, and greens, creating a pastoral and neutral tone. The edge of the lid is accented with a narrow, blue and yellow decorative band, patterned with small motifs. The composition is balanced with figures distributed around the scene, interspersed among the trees and landscape elements. The entire drawing has a soft, faded appearance due to the light beige background and gentle shading.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
